Gives the buffer of the desktop, which is behind all windows. Drawing to it paints on the background that windows sit on.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("In front", 40, 20, 240, 120, Desktop(), 3)
SetBuffer DesktopBuffer()
Color 255, 160, 0
For i = 0 To 7
	Oval 20 + i * 36, 170, 30, 30, 1
Next
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@returns A buffer handle.
@gap The desktop is the window of the program, so this is the same buffer as `FrontBuffer()`, not the screen of the computer. What you draw here is the backdrop of the windows: it stays when the interface is drawn again, and drawing later shows up. The original draws on the Windows desktop with the DirectDraw driver only.
